name: lean-orchestration
description: Route every non-trivial task for the highest-quality output per token: inline vs. subagent per phase, gates before LLMs, adversarial verification only where it pays, and a per-task ledger so follow-ups never lose context.

autostart.title: Load lean-orchestration at session start
autostart.description: Inject the routing skill at session start and re-arm it on every prompt, so it is in force from your first message. Turn off to load it yourself with /lean-orchestration:lean.

ledger_in_project.title: Store ledgers inside the project
ledger_in_project.description: Off: ledgers live in Claude's per-project directory (~/.claude/projects/<project>/lean-orchestration/), shared by every session of this project and kept out of the repo. On: ledgers live in <project>/.lean-orchestration/, where you can commit or ignore them.
